svg.title: Offline Progress Aligner
svg.desc: Editable reconstruction of reference A. Same-task complete human and robot sequences supply cached per-frame sets of 512-dimensional interaction tokens. The shared adapter produces normalized 128-dimensional frame embeddings. Cosine similarities enter monotonic two-way DTW and three filtering criteria. Reference lettering outlines and named vector groups; colored clip-art illustrations; no hand or gripper pose annotations. Illustrations and the similarity matrix are schematic, not experimental evidence.
